# x-twitter-scraper_x_broadcast (Data Source)

X live video details, watch counts, and broadcaster



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `broadcast` (Attributes) X broadcast, a live video (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--broadcast"></a>
### Nested Schema for `broadcast`

Read-Only:

- `camera_rotation` (Number) Camera rotation in degrees
- `chat_option` (Number) X's code for who may chat
- `creator` (Attributes) Public X profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator))
- `ended_at` (String) When the broadcast ended
- `height` (Number) Video height in pixels
- `id` (String) Broadcast ID
- `is_available_for_replay` (Boolean) Whether X offers a recording of the broadcast
- `is_high_latency` (Boolean) Whether the video stream runs in high-latency mode
- `is_private_chat` (Boolean) Whether X marks the chat private
- `is_title_edited` (Boolean) Whether the broadcaster edited the title of the replay
- `last_ping_at` (String) When the video stream last reached X
- `media_key` (String) X's media key for the video
- `periscope_user` (Attributes) Broadcaster, as X's live video service names the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--periscope_user))
- `pre_live_slate_url` (String) Image X shows before the broadcast starts
- `scheduled_start` (String) When the broadcast was set to start
- `source` (String) What produced the video stream, as X names it
- `started_at` (String) When the broadcast went live
- `state` (String) State, such as NotStarted, Running or Ended, as X names it
- `title` (String) Broadcast title
- `total_watched` (Number) Accounts that watched, live or after
- `total_watching` (Number) Accounts watching, as X counts them
- `tweet` (Dynamic) Search tweet with author. Zero metrics may mean X omitted counts.
- `tweet_id` (String) ID of the post that announces the broadcast
- `version` (Number) X's revision number of the broadcast
- `width` (Number) Video width in pixels

<a id="nestedatt--broadcast--creator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `broadcast.creator`

Read-Only:

- `account_based_in` (Attributes) Null when X shows no label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--account_based_in))
- `account_based_in_accurate` (Boolean) False when X notes accountBasedIn may be inaccurate.
- `account_based_in_unavailable` (Boolean) True when X withheld accountBasedIn from this read. Retry later.
- `advertiser_account_service_levels` (List of String) X Ads services the account uses, such as `analytics`, `media_studio` or `smb`. Empty for an account without ads.
- `advertiser_account_type` (String) The account's X Ads type. `none` for an account without ads, or `promotable_user` for one that may run them.
- `affiliate_username` (String) Handle of the organization X shows the account is affiliated with, from its About page.
- `affiliates_highlighted_label` (Attributes) Organization affiliation label shown on an X profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--affiliates_highlighted_label))
- `automated_by` (String)
- `birthdate` (Attributes) The parts of the birthday the account made public. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--birthdate))
- `business_account_affiliates_count` (Number)
- `business_profile_state` (String) Whether X treats the profile as a business profile. `none` or `enabled`.
- `community_role` (String) Community role when returned by community member reads
- `connected_via` (String) How the account first connected to X.
- `connected_via_accurate` (Boolean) False when X notes that country may be inaccurate.
- `contact_info` (Attributes) Emails, phone numbers & links the account publishes on its own profile. Omitted when it publishes none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info))
- `cover_picture` (String)
- `created_at` (String) Account creation time.
- `creator_subscriptions_count` (Number)
- `default_profile` (Boolean) Whether the profile keeps X's default theme.
- `default_profile_image` (Boolean) Whether the profile keeps X's default avatar.
- `description` (String)
- `email` (String) First email the account publishes on its profile, lowercased. Omitted when it publishes none.
- `fast_followers_count` (Number) Followers X counts as fast followers.
- `favourites_count` (Number)
- `followers` (Number) Omitted when X sends no count, as for the account that first posted reused media.
- `following` (Number)
- `geo_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the profile may add a location to posts.
- `grok_translated_bio` (Map of String) Public profile bio translation returned by X
- `has_custom_timelines` (Boolean)
- `has_extended_profile` (Boolean) Whether the profile filled X's extended fields, such as a birth date. True or false.
- `has_graduated_access` (Boolean)
- `has_hidden_subscriptions_on_profile` (Boolean)
- `highlights_info` (Attributes) Profile highlight availability and count metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--highlights_info))
- `id` (String)
- `identity_verification` (Attributes) Identity verification X shows on the profile & its About page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--identity_verification))
- `is_automated` (Boolean)
- `is_blue_verified` (Boolean) Whether X shows a blue verification badge
- `is_profile_translatable` (Boolean)
- `is_translation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account turned on X's translation of its posts. True or false.
- `is_translator` (Boolean)
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether X marks the profile as verified
- `listed_count` (Number) Public lists that include the profile.
- `location` (String) Account owner's public profile location text
- `media_count` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `normal_followers_count` (Number) Followers minus fast followers.
- `parody_commentary_fan_label` (String)
- `pinned_tweet_ids` (List of String)
- `possibly_sensitive` (Boolean)
- `professional` (Map of String) Professional metadata with category display settings
- `profile_banner_url` (String) Original X profile banner field when available
- `profile_bio` (Map of String) Structured profile bio with entity annotations
- `profile_description_language` (String)
- `profile_image_shape` (String)
- `profile_interstitial_type` (String)
- `profile_picture` (String) Profile picture at 48 px, as X sends it.
- `profile_picture_original` (String) The same profile picture at full size, as the account uploaded it. Download this one for the image.
- `profile_sort_enabled` (Boolean)
- `profile_translator_type` (String)
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the profile protects its posts
- `redirects_to_username` (String) Handle x.com sends this profile's visitors to, such as the new handle of a renamed account whose old handle now holds a placeholder. Missing when x.com shows the profile itself.
- `retweeted_at` (String) UTC repost time with includeRetweetTimestamp. Null if the newest profile page has no match or lookup failed. Otherwise omitted.
- `statuses_count` (Number)
- `subscribers_count` (Number) Accounts subscribed to the profile's paid Subscriptions. 0 when it has none.
- `super_follow_eligible` (Boolean)
- `super_follows_user_profile_active` (Boolean) Whether X marks the subscription profile as active.
- `tip_jar` (Attributes) Public payment and creator-support handles shown on X. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--tip_jar))
- `unavailable` (Boolean)
- `unavailable_reason` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `username` (String)
- `username_changes` (Attributes) How often the account changed its username. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--username_changes))
- `verification_reason` (Attributes) X's text on why the profile is verified, with its links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--verification_reason))
- `verified` (Boolean)
- `verified_type` (String)
- `withheld_in_countries` (List of String)
- `withheld_scope` (String) Whether X withholds a post or user

<a id="nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `broadcast.creator.contact_info`

Read-Only:

- `emails` (Attributes List) Emails in the bio, name or location, lowercased. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info--emails))
- `links` (Attributes List) The profile's website & the links in its bio. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info--links))
- `phones` (Attributes List) Phone numbers on the profile. Only a spelling that can be nothing else counts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info--phones))

<a id="nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info--emails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `broadcast.creator.contact_info.emails`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The part after the @ sign.
- `source` (String) Profile field that holds the email.
Available values are "bio", "name" and "location".
- `value` (String) The email address.
- `written_as` (String) The account's own spelling, sent when it spelled the email out.


<a id="nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `broadcast.creator.contact_info.links`

Read-Only:

- `network` (String) Site the link belongs to, such as `linkedin`, `github` or `telegram`. Any other site is `website`.
- `source` (String) `url` for the website field, `bio` for a bio link.
Available values are "url" and "bio".
- `url` (String) The link, as X expands it.


<a id="nestedatt--broadcast--creator--contact_info--phones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `broadcast.creator.contact_info.phones`

Read-Only:

- `source` (String) Profile field that holds the number.
Available values are "bio", "name", "location" and "url".
- `value` (String) The digits, with a leading + when the account wrote a country code.
- `written_as` (String) The account's own spelling of the number.
